name: Neural Primitive Splatting
aliases: Neural Density Field with Splattable Primitives
definition: A rendering method using a mixture of volumetric primitives, where each primitive is bounded by an ellipsoid and contains a shallow neural network that defines a spatially varying density field. Rendering uses analytic closed-form integration of this density along view rays to compute splatting kernels, avoiding ray marching.
summary: Neural Primitive Splatting is a volumetric representation using ellipsoid-bounded primitives with neural density fields, differing from Gaussian Splatting by defining the kernel as a neural network rather than a Gaussian function.
